post.caption: In 1953 the President of Brazil gave Queen Elizabeth II an aquamarine necklace and earrings as a coronation gift. In 1957 she asked Garrard for a matching tiara, a bandeau with three upright aquamarines in diamonds, and wore the whole set to a Royal Film Performance in London. Brazil added a bracelet and a brooch in 1958, and in 1971 Garrard made the tiara much larger. She was last photographed in it at a state banquet in July 2017.
